[[File:Event-button.PNG|center]]
Realm Grinder '''Events''' take place at annual festivals such as Thanksgiving, Christmas, Easter etc. Playing during an Event gives the players special one-time Trophies and temporary and/or permanent perks.

== Event Items ==
* '''Feats:''' Special kind of Trophies which can only be unlocked during their respective Event. Feats may have any kind of requirement and you will sometimes have to discover what you need to do by yourself.

* '''Event Quests:''' Missions entirely based on event-specific mechanics that can be completed during their respective Event.

Completing quest series awards a <u>permanent bonus</u> which will add to the bonuses from other quest series to make one all buildings bonus. The bonus of each quest series is determined with <math>(0.5 * (2 - x + x^2))%</math> where x is the number of quests completed in the series.

Most event items are temporary and can only be seen, and acquired<ref name=":0">''For new players, there is sometimes the possibility to catch up on feats. eg: see Thanksgiving 2015 and 2016''</ref>, during the event in question. Once it is finished, all the items will disappear, and only the feats and permanent bonuses will remain ([[:File:Event pannel feats.png|Image]]).

== Event Announcements ==
Events are announced a few days in advance, by DivineGames, in the [http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder Realm Grinder forum] at Kongregate.com. A copy of these announcements can be found on the [[Updates#Events|updates page]].

| colspan="5" |[[File:Pumpkin.png|thumb|86x86px|left]]This event will feature daily presents: '''Pumpkins''' ([[:File:HaloweenEvent-PumpkinPresent.png|image]]). You will get a Pumpkin Smasher once a day (1:01 PM UTC Time).<br />You will receive some 75 of each resources and a Ruby with each Pumpkin Smasher.<br />The first Pumpkin Smasher will give you 1 of the 3 Monsters.<br />The next 2 Pumpkins will give you one of the remaining Monsters.

Activating your first Monster will unlock the upgrade, '''''Crucible Of Darkness'''''.

There will be three unique resources for the event:
<center><div style="display:table-cell;padding-right:10px;">[[File:Blood.png]]<br />'''Blood'''</div><div style="display:table-cell;padding:10px;">[[File:Ectoplsm.png|46x46px]]<br />'''Ectoplasm'''</div><div style="display:table-cell;padding:10px;">[[File:Bone.png|46x46px]]<br />'''Bones'''</div></center>
They will appear in a random location of the game screen at a rate of 1 per minute, stacking up to a maximum of 720 units in 12 hours [http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder/topics/663882-realm-grinder-developers-diary-aug-11th-2017?page=4]. You can only collect one type of resource at a time, the others will disappear. Each resource will be used to feed a one of the monsters, which will upgrade its levels as it grows.

Once you have found a monster, you will be able to feed it to make it grow, unlocking perks and bonuses in the process. At levels 1, 10, 25 and 50 each monster will grant you new perks, including unique spells and upgrades. You will be able to choose which monster to take advantage of by toggling them on and off in the Event panel.

As usual, there will be Quests and Feats to unlock.

A Halloween Event guide is also available by clicking on the question mark on the top right of the Events tab ([[:File:HalloweenEventGuide.png|image]]).

| colspan="5" |[[File:Gobin Crown.png|left]]During the Goblin Invasion event you will be able to collect Goblin Crowns. This resource will be used to either '''fight''' or '''support''' the invading Goblin Army. Both choices will grant you new bonuses and unlock new unique upgrades.

Goblin Crowns will appear on a random location of the game screen and you simply have to click to collect them, then wait for another Goblin Crown to appear. Or, you can let them grow bigger over time (at a rate of 1 Goblin Crown per minute) if you are idle or offline — up to a maximum size of 480 Goblin Crowns!

Note: Required GCs to level per faction: 203 to level 25; 740 to level 50; 2685 to level 100

Total: 5370 GCs to level both factions to 100; Total time: 3 days 17 hours 30 minutes (without scrying).

| colspan="5" |[[File:Holy Symbols.png|left]][[File:Lava Stones.png|left]]'''Holy Symbols''' and '''Lava Stones''' will appear on a random location of the game screen and you simply have to click to collect them, then wait for more Resources to appear. Or you can let them grow bigger over time (at a rate of 1 Resource per Minute) if you are idle or offline, up to a maximum size of 480 Holy Symbols or Lava Stones! Be careful though, you can only collect one stack of Holy Symbols or Lava Stones - by doing so, the other will disappear.

Note: 2350 of each needed to get all the upgrades.

Note: All upgrades have a 1 time cost but need activation every Abdication/Reincarnation.

| colspan="5" |[[File:Easter Resource.png|left]]'''Event Theme''': Eggs. They will appear in a random location of the game screen at a rate of 1 per minute, stacking up to 480 eggs (8 hours) if you are idle or offline (image). When collected, each of them will produce one random Egg among three different types: Common, Rare and Unique:
* '''Common Eggs:''' Random colored eggs that will work as the primary currency for the Easter Event.
* '''Rare Eggs:''' Blue-colored eggs that also work as a currency for buying and increasing the bonus of an upgrade that boosts your production.
* '''Unique Eggs:''' Uniquely shaped and colored eggs that you can only find once per type. There are 8 Unique Eggs to find, and each one of them will unlock an unique upgrade (see below).

All eggs of all kinds will stack in one bundle based on their rarity until collected.

Event announcement source post

| colspan="5" |'''Egg Find chance:'''

The chance to find a common, rare or unique egg is based on your event's generated random number (RNG). Finding and buying eggs are not the same: Buying eggs will shift, your event's RNG ahead by +1. (If the RMI shows you will get an unique egg in 3002 egg finds, and you then buy 1 rare egg, the RMI will then show 3001.)

You can check what your next eggs will be and try aim, and avoid missing, a rare or unique egg using the seasonal RAB tool:
* [http://dox4242.github.io/mri/index.html Meggnetic Resonance Imager] - Courtesy of dox4242 (source)

Buying eggs will not influence your Common Eggs total, and the bought/converted egg will be add to your total rare/unique eggs.

Estimated Find chance by catdrake (source)
* Common: 95.27643%
* Rare: 4.56406%
* Unique: 0.15952%

'''Notes:'''
* Eggs will hatch if you warp time, therefore your Egg on screen will not grow during Timewarps.
* Event Scrying choice: Produce 1 random egg every 5 min for 4 hours.

'''Tips:'''<br />
Moving Egg stacks: You cannot move an egg stack, but refreshing the page will randomly place it elsewhere. (source)

| colspan="5" |It will feature a new resource, Hearts , which can be collected passively at a rate of 1 per second. You will be able to increase your Heart production by doing any of the following:

* Casting Call to Love will increase your Hearts per second rate based on its activity time. The rate increases to 2/second at about 2,000 seconds (33 minutes) and 3/s at 200,000 seconds (2 days, 7 hours, 33 minutes).
* Scrying and choosing the right option will temporarily increase your Hearts per second both online and offline.

As usual, there will be Quests and Feats to unlock: you will be able to find every information you need in the Events panel in game! Note: Event Feat requirements will no longer be hidden before you unlock them.
